text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Oil and industry ministry offers investment opportunities worth $400 million in the industry sector.
- A new law for companies to be implemented in Bahrain in 1998, commerce minister says.
- Trade exchanges between Bahrain and Egypt worth around $10 million, Egyptian ambassador says.
- Bahrain to increase training spending to 55 million dinars in 1997, labour minister says.
